about: Six Bits: a terminal short on Shannon and the six lines, about 60 s. The user, 2026-09-30: 'shannon information theory does have relation to the i-ching, in the sense that the bits contain information and the 6 bits describe things with max entropy/efficiency', then 'yes please write up the shannon short' and 'spec looks good'. Design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-30-shannon-six-bits-design.md.
hexagramNote: the end card and its track come from 22, as in the two lessons, so the terminal pieces end alike
style: The header reads 'SIX LINES // READY FOR INQUIRY' throughout. Each query clears the screen like a filmbook page. The query is typed after '>' (dim green); the answer types out below it (bright green, 48 px); the part of the readout the answer is about is drawn beside it, alone. Chapter pages: a single word, centred, held 2 s. Own names only, never MU/TH/UR or INTERFACE 2037.

music.why: calm, 90 bpm, G major, from 0 s as on 24 (Return); apart from the lessons' The Mountain

caption: Six lines, each yin or yang: six bits, 64 patterns. Claude Shannon measured information in bits in 1948.

pages.q: HOW MUCH CAN ONE LINE SAY
pages.a:
YIN OR YANG.
ONE CHOICE OF TWO.
ONE BIT.

2 X 2 X 2 X 2 X 2 X 2 = 64.
SIX BITS. 64 PATTERNS.

CLAUDE SHANNON, 1948.
INFORMATION, COUNTED IN BITS.

ONLY IF ALL 64
ARE EQUALLY LIKELY.

COINS: YIN OR YANG, HALF AND HALF.
YARROW: 8 IN 16 EACH WAY.
SIX FULL BITS EITHER WAY.

pages.q: DID SHANNON READ THE I CHING
pages.a:
NOT THAT WE CAN FIND.
THE STRUCTURE IS SHARED,
NOT BORROWED.

pages.q: SO WHAT DO SIX BITS HOLD
pages.a:
ONE SITUATION OUT OF 64.
WHAT TO DO IN IT
IS JUDGMENT.
